g.title: room
g.text: append-only; written and read with F_NOCACHE
moment k fills tokens start … start + tokens − 1 (from index.json); n ≤ 512
read whole, in 1 MB pieces, eight at once (preadv)

g.title: index
g.text: moments[ ]: mid · room · day · text · start · tokens

g.title: vectors
g.text: float32 matrix, one unit row per moment
row i is moment mid = i

g.title: events
g.text: one JSON object per line; every line has type and at
remember: moment · room · day · tokens · new_room
answer, agent: question · room · closest · nodes · share ·
verdict: event (line of the answer) · verdict · expected

g.title: record
g.text: kind · persona · seed · questions · weeks_planned · started · finished
contender{ }: name · reader · room_tokens · join · closest · token_bytes
environment{ }: machine · chip · memory_gb · power · load_1m ·
python · commit · dirty · source sha · mlx · mlx_lm · numpy
weeks[ ]: week · date · notes_so_far · quiz_s · peak_ram_gb · disk_mb
summary{ }: knows · told · honest · false_memories · stale ·
answers[ ]: qid · kind · question · expected · answer ·

g.title: token
g.text: 28 layers × 2 (K, V) × 8 KV heads × 128 numbers × 2 bytes (Eq. 4.4)
